verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents mechanisms that let users control the lifecycle of their own data—destroying an instance removes its ephemeral storage, while volumes provide separate persistent storage that can be explicitly created/reattached/deleted—giving some practical control over data retention. However, there is no explicit privacy-policy documentation on data retention periods, deletion guarantees, or compliance with data-deletion requests (e.g., GDPR-style erasure). Missing for 10: explicit data retention/deletion policy docs, guarantees about host-side data wiping after instance termination, and any compliance certification tied to data deletion.
